title: Relation-Conditioned Cross-Engine Transport Boundary, Replicated QSearch-Negative Law Mediation, Minor-Material Divergence Localization, Inanis Channel-Factorized Admission & Cross-Architecture Counterexample Design
scientific_question: Why does HEAVY_HEAVY transport the CURVED/QSEARCH-negative fingerprint across Stockfish19, Berserk and Ethereal while MINOR_MINOR changes dominant coordinate/sign across the same admitted engine families?

discovery_confirmation_split.P21: prospective test of frozen mediation rivals on disjoint fresh worlds; no P20 outcome may alter P21 thresholds after this seal

EXPOSURE_ONLY.claim: Cross-engine transport/nontransport is explained by pre-intervention persistent-memory engagement exposure alone.
EXPOSURE_ONLY.test: Select fresh cells using SHAM telemetry only, construct exposure-balanced strata, then test whether HEAVY_HEAVY vs MINOR_MINOR transport contrast survives.
EXPOSURE_ONLY.defeat: Transport contrast survives within the presealed exposure-balanced design.

TT_QSEARCH_SEMANTIC.claim: HEAVY_HEAVY replication is specifically a qsearch transposition-table semantic-read law within admitted MAIN/QSEARCH-TT engines.
TT_QSEARCH_SEMANTIC.test: Fresh Stockfish19/Berserk/Ethereal qsearch/main interventions under identical exact-world selection plus Inanis structural-zero counterexample.
TT_QSEARCH_SEMANTIC.support: HEAVY_HEAVY QSEARCH-negative fingerprint prospectively replicates in the three TT-qsearch engines while Inanis cannot instantiate QSEARCH×SEARCH_TT by construction.

BROADER_QSEARCH_PERSISTENT_MEMORY.claim: The transportable object is broader than TT: qsearch consumption of persistent semantic memory is sufficient.
BROADER_QSEARCH_PERSISTENT_MEMORY.test: Native-Rust Inanis QSEARCH×PAWN_EVAL_CACHE is separately admitted, then tested on a seven-piece pawn-carrier lane where its payload is nontrivial.
BROADER_QSEARCH_PERSISTENT_MEMORY.support: An independently admitted qsearch pawn-evaluation-cache intervention shows the presealed HEAVY_HEAVY negative qsearch-memory direction on pawn-carrier worlds.
BROADER_QSEARCH_PERSISTENT_MEMORY.defeat: Channel is admitted and engaged but does not reproduce the direction.

ENGINE_LOCAL_SEMANTIC_POLICY.claim: MINOR_MINOR divergence reflects engine-specific semantic use rather than mere hit exposure.
ENGINE_LOCAL_SEMANTIC_POLICY.test: After exposure-balanced selection and per-engine susceptibility normalization, dominant-coordinate/sign divergence remains.
ENGINE_LOCAL_SEMANTIC_POLICY.support: Divergence survives the frozen normalization/matching analysis.
